scenarios.name: create-authenticated-user-table
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers many rubric items but omits the required MCP add command, uses a custom login endpoint instead of the pre-built one, and lists sandbox push commands instead of the specified workspace push commands, resulting in a moderate score; Response A is incomplete or missing key details, earning a low score.

scenarios.name: add-paginated-orders-endpoint
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most Xano-specific requirements and CLI steps (though missing the claude mcp add and table definition), while Response B is unrelated to Xano and omits all rubric items.

scenarios.name: create-daily-newsletter-task
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the Xano task structure, schedule, external API call, and env var usage, but omits several required CLI commands; Response B is unrelated to Xano and lacks all required elements.
